body:
## Task

Workstream 2 — Comprehensive Live Defense end-to-end testing.
Pillar / subsystem: P2 sec / infra (test harness only)

## What changed and why

A reproducible owned-staging integration-testing system for the Live Defense
first-responder pipeline. Everything runs against real HTTP routes, the real
PostgreSQL database, the real durable job queue (`worker.drain`), and the real
`security_agents` runtime loop; only the model is scripted
(`provider_mode="fake"` on every record).

**Stacked on the corrected A+B integration heads** — this PR's base branch
`base/phase7c-execution-reliability` is the merge `15a34a1b` of the corrected
heads `5417990f` (Phase 7C, provider ledger: reserve-before-complete, crash
→ uncertain attempt, no automatic second billable request, Anthropic
Idempotency-Key, cancel/OFF rechecked before persist) and `f2d911d7`
(execution reliability: emergency claim capacity, lease fencing, audited
defer, OFF sweep over waiting+recovery_required), plus one compose fixup
`4828dd26` (dropped a stale `defer` redefinition). The diff shows only the
testing work and the reliability-queue compatibility tests run live, ungated.
Do not merge; retarget once the integration lands. No Grok/Phase-7C or
Devin-Reliability production code is modified here; docs files they own
(`SESSION_HANDOFF.md`, `HACKATL_TASKS.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) are untouched.

Also fixes two upstream bugs found in `466df4b7` that broke
`backend/tests/test_sandbox_target.py` on the new base (not
live-defense/reliability code): `AssessmentState.completed` → `COMPLETED` in
`deploy/sandbox_target.py`, and the recipe test now dispatches on each
route's declared method with `body_template` placeholders resolved instead
of GETting every route.

- `backend/tests/live_defense_e2e/harness.py` — `OwnedStaging`: project + repo
  + scope, owned-repo git checkouts, app registration, ingest tokens,
  owner-attested deploy mapping, snapshot rows, mode API, telemetry ingest,
  worker drain, job/scope/artifact/lease inspection helpers (lease expiry uses
  the database clock — review finding F10). Public API + tables only, so later
  phases can reuse it.
- `backend/tests/live_defense_e2e/transports.py` — fault injectors for
  `GATEWAY_OVERRIDE`: `FailAfterCalls` (provider dies mid-run), `HookProvider`
  (side effect on the Nth call, e.g. flip mode OFF), `CrashAfterSend` (records
  the physical call then raises `BaseException` — worker death after the
  billable send, before the response), `adversarial_scout_script` (denied
  tools + forged `verified`/`permission` fields).
- `backend/tests/live_defense_e2e/test_scenarios.py` — scenarios A–R:
  A successful investigation (telemetry → `confirm_with_probe` → Scout+Diagnose
  executed → artifacts → handoff ack; `confirm` still refused, hypotheses stay
  unverified); B missing authorization; C stale snapshot; D provider failure
  mid-run (partial transcript retained, honest `LLM_UNAVAILABLE`); E worker
  crash + recovery — **physical provider calls counted separately from logical
  invocations**: the crash commits the invocation `failed` honestly, the
  re-delivered step is a terminal no-op and physical scout calls do NOT
  double — duplicate-prevention is proven by physical-call counting, not
  logical-invocation count; F OFF
  mid-investigation via the real mode API; G multi-project isolation;
  H adversarial model output; I concurrent workers; J queue redelivery
  no-op; K provider death after a truncated turn; L OFF during an active
  provider call; M stale deployment mapping; N artifact corruption + missing
  bytes; O cross-project artifact 404; P duplicate ingestion dedupe;
  Q expired authorization scope; R OFF suppresses dispatch.
- `backend/tests/live_defense_e2e/test_exec_reliability_compat.py` — runs
  **live on the reliability queue** (no skip gate): depends_on ordering,
  per-project claim fairness, deadline `timed_out` on the DB clock,
  uncertain effect → `recovery_required`, and deadline durability through
  claim → lease expiry → reconcile → requeue. F1 and F8 are **fixed on the
  corrected head** and now pass as real regressions:
  - **F1** crash-after-send/before-response → forced redelivery never sends
    a second physical billable call (in-flight attempt defers or commits
    `UNCERTAIN_PROVIDER_OUTCOME`); the job may re-claim, the call is never
    replayed.
  - **F8** OFF flipped during final-submit persistence wins — the
    invocation stays cancelled, never upgraded to `executed`.
  One defect stays pinned as `xfail(strict=True)` (XPASS = drop the marker):
  - **F7** `deadline_at` reaches the decision/invocation/step payload but
    not the `jobs.deadline_at` column — the queue cannot time the job out.
- `frontend/tests/e2e/live-defense-e2e.spec.ts` — Playwright OFF-mode
  interruption through the real UI on a dedicated seeded `E2E_LD_*` project
  (the first-responder page renders one invocation row per agent
  project-wide; isolating avoids colliding with the Phase 7C spec).
- `.github/workflows/live-defense-e2e.yml` — `smoke`, `full`, `fault` jobs;
  `live` is manual-only, gated on `vars.RUN_LIVE_LLM_E2E` and the authorized
  `secrets.HACKATL_LIVE_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.
- `Makefile` targets `e2e-ld-smoke` / `e2e-ld` / `e2e-ld-fault` / `e2e-ld-live`;
  machine-readable JSON results per run in `test-results/live-defense-e2e/`.

## Evidence it works

```
$ uv run pytest -q backend/tests -m live_defense_e2e
25 passed, 4 skipped, 1 xfailed   # skips: live_llm + rl-eval (opt-in);
                                  # xfail: F7 only (F1/F8 fixed upstream)

$ uv run pytest -q backend/tests/test_live_defense_phase7c.py backend/tests/test_live_defense_phase7c_review.py
31 passed on the corrected A+B composed head

$ uv run pytest -q backend/tests/test_execution_reliability.py backend/tests/test_jobs_queue.py
56 passed   # incl. B's emergency-capacity/lease-fencing/deferral tests

$ uv run pytest -q backend/tests
424 passed, 8 skipped, 1 xfailed   # sandbox-target recipe test fixed upstream

$ cd frontend && ../.venv/bin/python tests/e2e/stack.py \
    tests/e2e/live-defense-e2e.spec.ts tests/e2e/live-defense-phase7c.spec.ts
2 passed (40.4s)

$ uv run ruff check backend/tests/live_defense_e2e && uv run ruff format --check backend/tests/live_defense_e2e
All checks passed!
```

FakeLLM coverage does not validate real Anthropic execution; the live tier
(`make e2e-ld-live`) stays opt-in and unrun without an authorized key.

## Checklist

- [x] Scope matches the task; no unrelated changes
- [x] Tests added/updated and passing locally (listed above)
- [x] Uses `shared/` contracts; no locally redefined shared models
- [x] No contract change
- [x] No secrets, customer code, or third-party exploit details
- [x] Docs updated (package README + `docs/devin_qa/LIVE_DEFENSE_E2E.md`; files owned by #458 deliberately untouched)
- [x] No attribution trailers in commits

## Risks / follow-ups

- Stacked on the corrected A+B compose (`4828dd26`); retarget once the
  integration lands on `main`.
- F7 remains pinned as a strict xfail — `jobs.deadline_at` column is NULL on
  step jobs; the fix is owned by the execution workstream.
- Two upstream bugs from `466df4b7` are fixed here (sandbox-target recipe
  test): a broken `AssessmentState.completed` enum reference and a recipe
  test that GETted POST routes.
- Live-provider tier is unverified until run with an authorized key.
